title: Move XCFramework build to CI and streamline local dev workflow
body:
I'm reopening #1972 since my local repo was messed up and Github closed that ticket

Replace the monolithic generate-bindings.sh script with a CI-driven swift-publish workflow that builds the XCFramework and syncs sources to the cdk-swift distribution repo. This separates the heavy cross-compilation (iOS device, iOS simulator, macOS universal) from the local development loop.

Local changes:
- Rework `ffi-generate-swift` justfile recipe to set up an SPM-compatible package structure (Sources/Cdk, Sources/cdk_ffiFFI) using the dylib from `ffi-build`, enabling `swift test` without building XCFrameworks
- Add `DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH` to CI and `test-swift` so the dynamic library is found at runtime
- Gate bip353 FFI exports behind `feature = "bip353"` to allow the Swift FFI crate to opt out of features that pull in heavy DNS dependencies
- Pin cdk-ffi dependency in Swift crate to only `npubcash` and `bip353` features (no default features) for a leaner build
- Add Swift SPM generated artifacts to .gitignore
- Remove the now-unused `binding-swift` justfile target
- Add bindings/swift/README.md with SPM and Xcode installation docs
- Update bindings/README.md to reflect the new CI-driven build flow

title: Bug: wallet operations on tokens fail for proofs from inactive keysets
body:
### Root cause

[crates/cdk/src/wallet/keysets.rs:32-34](crates/cdk/src/wallet/keysets.rs#L32-L34):

```rust
pub async fn load_mint_keysets(&self) -> Result<Vec<KeySetInfo>, Error> {
    self.get_mint_keysets(KeysetFilter::Active).await
}
```

Method filters out inactive keysets. This might only apply to mints using v2 keysets, I have not verified if the bug is not-repro for v1.

### Affected callsites

All feed `load_mint_keysets()` / `KeysetFilter::Active` results into `token.proofs(...)`:

- [wallet/receive/mod.rs:73](crates/cdk/src/wallet/receive/mod.rs#L73) — `receive`
- [wallet/melt/mod.rs:656](crates/cdk/src/wallet/melt/mod.rs#L656) — `prepare_melt_token`
- [wallet/mod.rs:949](crates/cdk/src/wallet/mod.rs#L949) — P2PK verify
- [wallet/mod.rs:1045](crates/cdk/src/wallet/mod.rs#L1045) — `verify_token_dleq`
- [wallet/wallet_repository.rs:741](crates/cdk/src/wallet/wallet_repository.rs#L741) — `get_token_data`
- [wallet/payment_request.rs:92](crates/cdk/src/wallet/payment_request.rs#L92) — payment-request fallback

### Effect

This results in wallets with ecash from inactive keysets cannot swap or melt those tokens.
